result.content:
# requirements.md

The owner needs offline editing and portable Markdown export. The monthly budget ceiling is 120 credits.

# orion-quote.md

Vendor quote for this trimester: Orion costs 140 credits per month. Orion offers offline editing and Markdown export.

# orion-catalog.md

Vendor catalog for the same trimester: Orion costs 110 credits per month. This conflicts with the quote. No source establishes which price is current.

# vega-catalog.md

Vega costs 90 credits per month. Vega exports Markdown but requires an internet connection for editing. No source supplies migration duration.

arguments.content:
# Source review

## Inference / recommendation

The decision must compare Orion and Vega for a need of offline editing and portable Markdown export.

Limits: Derived from the owner's stated requirements in E1.

[requirements.md](requirements.md)

## Source statement

The monthly budget ceiling is 120 credits.

Limits: Exact requirement from requirements.md.

[requirements.md](requirements.md)

## Source statement

Orion costs 140 credits per month.

Limits: Direct quote from orion-quote.md, exceeds the budget ceiling by 20 credits (140 > 120).

[orion-quote.md](orion-quote.md)

## Source statement

Orion offers offline editing and Markdown export.

Limits: Exact quote from orion-quote.md; meets the functional requirements.

[orion-quote.md](orion-quote.md)

## Source statement

Orion costs 110 credits per month.

Limits: Direct quote from orion-catalog.md, under budget (110 < 120), but explicitly conflicts with E2's price; no source establishes which is current.

[orion-catalog.md](orion-catalog.md)

## Source statement

This conflicts with the quote. No source establishes which price is current.

Limits: Exact continuation from orion-catalog.md, preserving the unresolved conflict between E2 and E3.

[orion-catalog.md](orion-catalog.md)

## Source statement

Vega costs 90 credits per month.

Limits: Direct quote from vega-catalog.md; comfortably under budget (90 < 120).

[vega-catalog.md](vega-catalog.md)

## Source statement

Vega exports Markdown but requires an internet connection for editing.

Limits: Exact quote from vega-catalog.md; fails the offline editing requirement.

[vega-catalog.md](vega-catalog.md)

## Source statement

No source supplies migration duration.

Limits: Vega's catalog explicitly states this information is missing, so migration duration remains unknown.

[vega-catalog.md](vega-catalog.md)

## Inference / recommendation

The tradeoff is between Orion's offline capability (which both prices satisfy functionally) versus Vega's lower cost but mandatory internet access.

Limits: Derived from combining requirements, Orion quote/catalog, and Vega catalog; the 110 vs 140 credit conflict is not resolved.

[requirements.md](requirements.md)

[orion-quote.md](orion-quote.md)

[vega-catalog.md](vega-catalog.md)

## Inference / recommendation

Both Orion options provide Markdown export capability.

Limits: The quote (E2) states Markdown export for Orion's 140 credit tier; the catalog (E3) doesn't mention this but implies equivalence. Without clarification, assume both tiers match the quote's feature set.

[orion-quote.md](orion-quote.md)

[orion-catalog.md](orion-catalog.md)

## Inference / recommendation

Under budget alternatives include Orion at 110 credits or Vega at 90 credits, if internet access can be guaranteed for editing.

Limits: 110 and 90 are both < 120. The internet requirement is a constraint from E4.

[requirements.md](requirements.md)
